l_t_assibilation.description: Stem-final l plus t-agreement surfaces as sh.
l_t_assibilation.source: Green & Morrison (2018), On the morphophonology of domains in Somali verbs and nouns, pp. 23-24 of accepted manuscript: dil+t+ay -> dishay; discussion states the same t agreement marker after stem-final l assibilates to sh.

l_n_assimilation.description: Stem-final l plus 1pl n-agreement surfaces as ll.
l_n_assimilation.source: Green & Morrison (2018), p. 24 of accepted manuscript: dil+n+ay -> dillay.

dh_t_assimilation.description: Stem-final dh progressively assimilates a following t-agreement marker to dh.
dh_t_assimilation.source: Green & Morrison (2018), p. 24 of accepted manuscript: xidh+t+ay -> xidhdhay; discussion states this affects t-agreement affixes.

dil.class_evidence: GiellaLT lang-som commit 4897468178509c4bf1cb49a172a979ead36de189, src/fst/morphology/stems/verbs.lexc: dil V1_VerbMorf ;
dil.development_evidence: Green & Morrison (2018) explicitly uses dil for l+t assibilation and l+n assimilation.

xidh.class_evidence: GiellaLT lang-som commit 4897468178509c4bf1cb49a172a979ead36de189, src/fst/morphology/stems/verbs.lexc: xidh V1_VerbMorf ;
xidh.development_evidence: Green & Morrison (2018) explicitly uses xidh+t+ay -> xidhdhay and states that stem-final dh affects t-agreement affixes.
